note: D5 adds NO runtime infrastructure: no resource, no cron entry, no secret, USD 0.00 per month, Terraform untouched. It adds two release-time CI gates, each placed where it is by a concrete constraint rather than preference - the size gate needs a signing keystore that exists only inside the release job protected environment, and the ZAP scan needs a deployed host no merge-time job has. Both new gates carry PRECONDITION ASSERTIONS in the same commit that introduces them - three for the ZAP job, because a size gate pointed at a missing AAB, a DAST scan against an unreachable host, and a scan whose schema failed to import all exit zero by default, and the third hides behind the second passing. This is the failure shape this project has now met three times in its own history. 6 Deferred rows, each naming a review-only prohibition, a recorded decision or a human step. Zero GAP rows.
